items.quip: Its botched translation coined "All your base are belong to us."
items.title: Zero Wing
items.extract: Zero Wing is a 1989 horizontally scrolling shooter video game developed by Toaplan and published by Namco for arcades. It was released in North America by Williams Electronics. Controlling the ZIG space fighter craft, players assume the role of protagonist Trent in a last-ditch effort to overthrow the alien space pirate organization CATS. It was the eighth shoot 'em up game from Toaplan, and their fourteenth video game overall.

prompts.text: Name a country that has been colonized by Spain or Portugal.

items.quip: Portugal held Hormuz, now part of Iran, from 1515 to 1622.
items.title: Iran
items.extract: Iran, officially the Islamic Republic of Iran, and historically known as Persia, is a country in West Asia. It borders Iraq to the west; Turkey, Azerbaijan, and Armenia to the northwest; the Caspian Sea to the north, Turkmenistan to the northeast; Afghanistan to the east; Pakistan to the southeast; and the Gulf of Oman and the Persian Gulf to the south. With a population of over 92 million, Iran ranks 17th globally in both geographic size and population. It is divided into five regions with 31 provinces. Tehran is the nation's capital and largest city and serves as its primary economic center.

prompts.text: Name a chemical element that makes up the human body.

items.quip: Your body contains gold, just not enough to retire on.
items.title: Gold
items.extract: Gold is a chemical element; its chemical symbol is Au and atomic number 79. In its pure form, it is a bright-metallic-yellow, dense, soft, malleable, and ductile metal. Chemically, gold is a transition metal, a group 11 element, and one of the noble metals. It is one of the least reactive chemical elements, being the second lowest in the reactivity series, with only platinum ranked as less reactive. Gold is solid under standard conditions.

prompts.text: Name an invention that existed before 1500 (no food or drinks).

items.quip: Overfilling a Pythagorean cup siphons its entire contents out through the stem.
items.title: Pythagorean cup
items.description: Cup with a central siphon drain
items.extract: A Pythagorean cup is a practical joke device in the form of a drinking cup. When it is filled beyond a certain point, a siphoning effect causes the cup to drain its entire contents through the base. The cup has been used to make statements about greed.

items.title: Miley Cyrus
items.extract: Miley Ray Cyrus is an American singer, songwriter, and actress. An influential figure in popular music, Cyrus is known for her evolving artistry and image reinventions. She was an established child actress before developing a successful entertainment career as an adult. Cyrus emerged as a teen idol with her portrayal of Miley Stewart in the Disney Channel television series Hannah Montana (2006–2011), growing a profitable franchise and achieving two number-one soundtracks on the US Billboard 200.

items.title: The Hound of Florence
items.extract: The Hound of Florence: A Novel is a 1923 novel written by Felix Salten. The novel was first translated into English in 1930 by Huntley Paterson, and the translation has illustrations by Kurt Wiese.
